about: Vapour + two liquids with acetic acid's dimerizing vapour (the chemical theory; decision docs/decisions/2026-11-12-02-acid-chemical-theory-vlle.md): flashes of water + acetic acid + ethyl acetate and columns whose stages hold two liquids. Engineering cases built for this check (not published problems): their answers are the independent reference's, validation/python/reference_vlle_acid.py (fixture validation/fixtures/vlle_acid.json), read by test/vlle-acid.test.js. Mole fractions in the order of components; flows in mol/s; feeds of the absorber at the stated temperature.
method_choice: docs/METHOD_SELECTION.md rule 3: polar, no electrolytes, 1 atm, two liquids possible, fitted pairs: NRTL (CHEPTA's default sets: water + acetic acid Chang et al. 2005, water + ethyl acetate Grande and Marschoff 2005, ethyl acetate + acetic acid Brandt et al. 2014) with an ideal-gas vapour; acetic acid's vapour by the chemical theory (monomers and dimers), CHEPTA's default for a dimerizing acid.

tolerances.why: As the other column cases (validation/data/columns/): both sides solve the same equations to residuals of 1e-10 or less, by different routes (the engine with the fugacity coefficients of the apparent vapour, the reference from the liquid side), so the difference is the solvers' tolerance.
